scope: P2-1 independent read-only review of frozen patch, applied source/docs, and exact-library lightweight probes
reviewer_role: independent reviewer; no production code, formal tests, or root workspace files written
conclusion: passed within the recorded scope; no blocking findings

static_findings.subject: Supported Vary selection
static_findings.result: Page freshness and conditional metadata accept absence or a bounded ASCII list containing only Accept-Encoding, case-insensitive with duplicates allowed. Empty list members, wildcard, mixed/unknown names, parameters, control/non-ASCII bytes and length >4096 remain unsupported. Explicit empty HTTP Vary is rejected before it can mean omitted metadata.

static_findings.subject: Request-profile binding
static_findings.result: Fetcher explicitly fixes gzip, deflate and computes the stored profile from final explicit headers immediately before the same headers are passed to aiohttp. Header names are folded; only resource validators are excluded. Cookie jar and environment proxies remain disabled. The worker checks the current profile before issuing a conditional GET; a changed selection uses the original grant for one complete GET.

static_findings.subject: Core reuse and 304 binding
static_findings.result: Owner/cache identity, current-profile RPC, exact URI/profile/binding, current base compare-and-swap, deletion and publication gates remain. Omitted 304 Vary cannot clear previous Accept-Encoding in either http_cache or http_freshness. Mixed Vary invalidates old reuse without automatic retry while retaining the historical body artifact.

static_findings.subject: Robots fixed-header boundary
static_findings.result: Robots freshness preserves the previously accepted fixed User-Agent/Accept dimensions and adds fixed Accept-Encoding. Conditional robots metadata stays encoding-only. Fresh parsed robots records do not contain a request_profile field; their safety depends on fixed CRAWLER_USER_AGENT, text/plain Accept and gzip/deflate Accept-Encoding within bzs-robots-1. Private/public map parameters cannot override request headers. Future changes to those selections require a policy identity change or explicit stored profile binding.

static_findings.subject: Other restrictions and documented scope
static_findings.result: No-store, no-cache, zero age, unrecognized Vary dimensions, unsupported 304, original grant/accounting, ACL/publication/site approval, backup quarantine and permanent identities are not broadened. Applied docs distinguish private owner freshness from the narrower conditional protocol and explicitly state the robots profile limitation.

covered: same-owner and matching-profile public cache reuse
omitted 304 Vary in both persisted metadata records
mixed Vary invalidates reuse without retry while body stays available

native_old_same_source.meaning: Original validator rejects the first supported nonempty Accept-Encoding case; this is the preserved expected before-fix counterexample.

covered: profile changes for UA/Accept/Accept-Language/Accept-Encoding, stable under header case and resource-validator changes
Vary matrix and omitted-vs-explicit-empty response handling
fixed robots Vary dimensions, retained body hash/rules, disallow/public decisions

limitations: Native Worker responses are explicit offline fixtures; this independent probe does not claim a real HTTP transport or loopback run.

Python checks invoke production header construction/profile/parser functions without opening sockets. Actual aiohttp request binding was reviewed statically; root formal HTTP and full project gates remain separate evidence.
The finite matrix and synthetic clock do not replace the full CTest/pytest/ASan gates or a future exact-commit CI run.
Robots fresh-record reuse assumes its documented fixed header selections; no future dynamic Accept-Encoding configuration is claimed.
evidence_policy: Bundle contains source, JSON and text logs only. Static libraries, executables and runtime databases are excluded.
